headline: Veteran Actor Nana Patekar Passes Away in Goa
summary: Veteran Bollywood actor Nana Patekar has passed away at the age of 75 at his Goa residence after suffering a cardiac arrest. Doctors at Goa's Manipal Hospital attempted to resuscitate him for 45 minutes but were unsuccessful.

headline: Nana Patekar's Last Video From Goa Event Surfaces Online
summary: A final video has emerged on social media showing Nana Patekar smiling, dancing, and playing the shamel at a Goa event. The footage was recorded just four days before his sudden death.

headline: CM Pramod Sawant Mourns Death of Nana Patekar
summary: Goa Chief Minister Pramod Sawant has mourned the passing of veteran actor Nana Patekar. He praised Patekar's distinctive artistry and the impact he left behind.

headline: A Look at Nana Patekar's Net Worth and Assets
summary: Following the veteran actor's demise at 75, details about Nana Patekar's net worth, including his Mumbai apartment, Goa residence, cars, and real estate assets, have come to light.

headline: Goa's Anti-BJP Opposition Alliance on Verge of Collapse
summary: The GFP-AAP alliance is reportedly on the verge of collapse as the anti-BJP coalition teeters. Allies are currently discussing the case for a grand unity.

headline: Congress and GFP Revive Alliance Talks Post-Festivals
summary: Following a Pitru Paksha pause, the Congress-GFP alliance is back in play. Both parties are aiming for a post-festival pact.

headline: Three-Day Voter Enrolment Camps Begin in Goa
summary: Three-day voter enrolment camps have officially commenced across the state. The initiative aims to facilitate voter registration.

headline: How Elections in Goa Have Changed Over the Years
summary: A retrospective analysis examines elections in Goa, comparing how campaigns and voting patterns were conducted in the past versus today.

headline: Deleted Voters Asked to Reapply After Media Exposure
summary: Following a recent media report, 97 deleted voters in Goa have been asked to submit Form 6. The action was initiated just one day after the report was published.

headline: Mother and Daughter Injured in New Vaddem Gas Cylinder Blast
summary: An LPG cylinder explosion at a residence in New Vaddem has left a mother and her daughter injured.

headline: MLC Demands Vande Bharat Train Stop at Mangaluru Central
summary: An MLC has requested that the proposed Goa-Bengaluru-Goa Vande Bharat train operate via Mangaluru Central instead of Mangaluru Junction.

headline: Taxi Rides in Goa Set to Become More Expensive
summary: Taxis in Goa are set to become costlier for commuters and visitors. The price hike comes as a result of a revised fare structure.

headline: South Goa Police Target Road Safety as Accidents Rise by 10%
summary: South Goa police are focusing on road user education to address a recorded 10% rise in accidents.

headline: Heritage Activists Oppose Construction Near Casa de Polvora
summary: Construction activities near the historic Casa de Polvora have irked heritage activists. Protesters are raising concerns over the impact on the historical landmark.

headline: Goa Highlighted Among Top Indian Off-Season Destinations
summary: Goa has been featured as one of five Indian destinations to visit during the off-season. Traveling during this period offers visitors fewer crowds and better deals.

headline: A Peek Inside the Iconic 'Drishyam' Bungalow in Goa
summary: An inside look reveals the iconic real-life Goa bungalow featured in Ajay Devgn's hit Drishyam film trilogy.

headline: Tawadkar Demands Dedicated Care Home for Isolated Persons
summary: Assembly Speaker Tawadkar has stated that a dedicated home is needed in Goa for persons living in complete isolation.

headline: Rahul Bind's Family Demands Crime Branch Probe
summary: The family of Rahul Bind is demanding the suspension of school teachers and a thorough Crime Branch probe into the case.

headline: Panaji Corporation Opposes Privatization of CoP Jetty
summary: The CCP has expressed opposition to the privatization of the CoP jetty. The corporation also opposes the introduction of floating jetties in the capital city.

headline: Shirodkar Urges Water Conservation After Weak Monsoon
summary: Shirodkar has urged citizens to practice water conservation following a weak monsoon. However, he assured that Goa currently has enough water supply.

headline: Drunk Driver Runs Over and Kills Footpath Sleeper in Panaji
summary: A drunken driver ran over a labourer who was sleeping on a footpath in Panaji, resulting in the victim's death.

headline: Weak Monsoon Destroys 20 Hectares of Paddy Fields in Goa
summary: A poor monsoon has damaged 20 hectares of paddy fields across Goa, impacting local agricultural output.

headline: Goa Records Over 10,000 Reptile Rescues in a Single Year
summary: Goa logged over 10,000 reptile rescues in a single year, averaging about 29 snake rescues per day.

headline: CCP Considers 11 PM Closing Time for Capital Bars
summary: The CCP is exploring an 11 PM cut-off time for bars following complaints from local residents.

headline: Bicholim Residents Demand Night Access to Bus Stand Toilets
summary: Residents of Bicholim are seeking nighttime access to the toilets located at the KTC bus stand.

headline: Terrarium Workshops Gain Popularity in Goa
summary: Terrarium workshops are finding a space in Goa, offering participants a creative way to build a slice of nature inside glass jars.

headline: Four Rescued From Fire in Calangute Apartment
summary: Four people were successfully rescued by emergency teams after a fire broke out in a Calangute flat.
